backlog.title: Hostable Viewport 0.2.0 — Conformance & Documentation
backlog.description: The 0.2.0 'hostable viewport (single shared modal)' feature is ALREADY IMPLEMENTED and shipped (v1.0.0, commit 1e09499). This phase's scope is strictly: (1) verify the existing implementation against the finalized PRD and close the one genuine conformance gap (popToIndex missing from the useFormStack() combined hook), and (2) sync the stale README.md so every 0.2.0 public symbol and the shared-modal pattern are documented. Re-implementing shipped code is explicitly forbidden. Research findings are stored in plan/002_32eb66cd705d/architecture/.

No new modules; all changes are in-place edits to existing files plus tests.

subtasks.title: Add popToIndex to the useFormStack() combined hook surface
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: audit_findings.md MISMATCH 1 — useFormStack() (src/hooks/useFormStack.ts:158-160) returns { stack, openForm, closeForm, cancelForm } but OMITS popToIndex, while useFormStackActions() exposes it and PRD §5.2 / delta §3 expect both hooks to surface it. The sibling action cancelForm is already on both hooks, so popToIndex's absence is an inconsistency. The fix is additive (~2 lines) and must be tested (implicit TDD).
2. INPUT: The FormStackActions interface (src/types/context.ts:67-103) already declares popToIndex: (index: number) => void. useFormStackActions() already returns it. The existing UseFormStackReturn interface and useFormStack() body (src/hooks/useFormStack.ts) are the targets.
3. LOGIC: Implement PRD §5.2 (popToIndex under useFormStack()). (a) Add `popToIndex: (index: number) => void;` to the UseFormStackReturn interface in src/hooks/useFormStack.ts, with a short JSDoc mirroring the cancelForm entry (reference <Breadcrumbs/> usage). (b) In the useFormStack() body, destructure popToIndex from useFormStackActions() and include it in the returned object. (c) TDD: add a test in src/hooks/__tests__/useFormStack.test.tsx asserting that useFormStack() exposes a callable popToIndex AND that calling it (on a 2-deep stack) cancels the deeper form — i.e. it is the same function the actions hook provides and is wired through. Mock nothing (use the real provider via test-utils). Follow the existing test patterns in that file.
4. OUTPUT: `const { popToIndex } = useFormStack()` is valid and functional. UseFormStackReturn now lists { stack, openForm, closeForm, popToIndex, cancelForm }. `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npx vitest run` remain green (286+ → 287+ tests).
5. DOCS: [Mode A] Add JSDoc for the new popToIndex member on UseFormStackReturn in src/hooks/useFormStack.ts as part of THIS subtask. This rides WITH the work — do not create a separate docs subtask. (README coverage of this new surface is handled by P1.M2.T1.S2.)
